logline: A young woman leaves her highland home with a single woven blanket, giving half away on a cold city night, only to discover years later that true warmth always finds its way back.
theme: Journey and courage: wide landscapes, dawn light, dust and gold
style_block: Hand-painted watercolor and gouache texture, golden dawn light, rich ochre and deep indigo palette, soft atmospheric bloom, expressive visible brushstrokes

people.statement: All characters are invented. The narrator is a stock synthetic voice.

am.style: warm, calm and unhurried, like telling a family story at night

en.style: warm, calm and unhurried, like telling a family story at night

character.prompt: portrait of a young East African woman with braided hair, brown skin, warm expressive eyes, wearing a simple earthy tunic

object.prompt: still life of a hand-woven wool blanket featuring traditional red, yellow, and blue geometric highland patterns

video.negative_prompt: text, letters, subtitles, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, morphing, flicker, fast motion, camera shake, blurry, low quality

music.caption: Instrumental acoustic guitar and soft traditional masenqo melodies, gentle ambient soundscape, no vocals

shots.reason: Establishes the origin journey from rural highlands into the unknown.
shots.image_prompt: A wide highland landscape bathed in soft golden dawn light, a young woman walking along a dusty dirt trail holding a folded woven blanket.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan right following the forward walk along the dusty trail as dawn light glimmers.

narration.am: ከቤት መውጣት ድፍረት ይጠይቃል፤ ነገር ግን የሚወዱንን ሰዎች ሞቅታ አብረን እንይዛለን።
narration.en: Leaving home takes courage, but we carry the warmth of those who love us.

shots.reason: Focuses on the heirloom blanket and its emotional connection to home.
shots.image_prompt: Hands gently resting upon a vibrant hand-woven wool blanket with red and yellow woven geometric patterns.
shots.motion_prompt: Static camera with a gentle slow zoom in on the hands resting on fabric.

narration.am: አክስቷ ይህንን ጋቢ የሸመነችው በሩቅ አገር ከሚነፍሰው የብርድ ንፋስ እንድትጠበቅ ነበር።
narration.en: Her aunt wove this blanket to shield her against distant winter winds.

shots.reason: Shows the scale and isolation of arriving in a new cold city.
shots.image_prompt: An extreme wide view of a bustling city street at dusk, golden dust in the air while a solitary traveler walks holding a bundle.
shots.motion_prompt: High angle camera slowly tilting down while tracking across the cityscape.

narration.am: በዚያች ቀዝቃዛ ከተማ ውስጥ እያንዳንዱ እንግዳ መንገድ ሰፊና ጭጭ ያለ ይመስል ነበር።
narration.en: In the bustling cold city, every unfamiliar street felt vast and silent.

shots.reason: Depicts her vulnerability and intent to sell her prized possession.
shots.image_prompt: A young woman sitting on a stone doorstep in a cool dusk setting, holding a folded woven blanket tightly.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle camera push in, keeping a static low angle framing.

narration.am: ትኩስ ምግብ ለመግዛት ያንን ውድ ሀብቷን ለመሸጥ አሲባ ነበር።
narration.en: She hoped to sell her cherished treasure to afford a simple warm meal.

shots.reason: Introduces the secondary character in need, inspiring compassion.
shots.image_prompt: A young child sitting in an alley doorway wrapped in a thin grey shawl, looking upward into the chilly night air.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pedestal up camera movement maintaining focus on the child looking upward.

narration.am: ነገር ግን አጠገቧ አንድ የሚንቀጠቀጥ ልጅ በብርዱ ውስጥ በደከሙ ዓይኖች ቀና ብሎ አያት።
narration.en: Nearby, a shivering child looked up with gentle, tired eyes in the frost.

shots.reason: Captures the pivotal selfless act of sharing the woven blanket.
shots.image_prompt: A hand-woven wool blanket cleanly divided into two matching halves lying softly across wooden boards.
shots.motion_prompt: Top down camera slowly zooming out to show the divided textile pieces.

narration.am: ጋቢውን ለሁለት በመክፈል እኩሌታውን በሚንቀጠቀጠው ህፃን ላይ ፍቅር በተሞላበት እጅ አሸፈነችው።
narration.en: She carefully divided the blanket, wrapping half around the small shivering child.

shots.reason: Marks the passage of time into the present day.
shots.image_prompt: A quiet sunlit city alley bathed in golden morning light, an older woman sitting near a warm window with half a woven blanket over her shoulders.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow horizontal camera pan from left to right across the sunlit wall.

narration.am: ብዙ የበረዶ ወራት አለፉ፤ ነገር ግን የዚያች ትንሽ ቸርነት ሞቅታ በውስጧ ህያው ሆኖ ቀረ።
narration.en: Many winters passed by, yet the memory of that small kindness remained warm.

shots.reason: Reveals the surprise return of the lost half of the blanket.
shots.image_prompt: A young adult standing in bright morning sunlight, holding out half of a faded hand-woven wool blanket with matching red and gold patterns.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle camera tilt up following the hands lifting the folded fabric.

narration.am: በአንድ ፀሐያማ ጠዋት አንድ ያደገ እንግዳ የተጠበቀውን የጋቢውን እኩሌታ ይዞ ተመለሰ።
narration.en: One bright morning, a grown youth returned holding the faded half woven cloth.

shots.reason: Completes the emotional arc, showing that kindness returns.
shots.image_prompt: Two pairs of hands bringing together two matching halves of a woven pattern blanket under warm morning sun rays.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow circular orbit around the central gesture as golden sunlight glints across the fabric.

narration.am: የተሰጠ የማንኛውም ፍቅር መልካምነት መጨረሻው ወደ እኛ ተመልሶ ይመጣል።
narration.en: Every act of pure love given away eventually finds its way back home.

lines: Pictures, voice and music made with AI
